script: The first spacewalk took place in 1965. Alexei Leonov floated outside his spacecraft for about 12 minutes. His suit puffed up so much that he struggled to get back inside. He had to let air out of his suit to squeeze through the hatch. Today, astronauts practice spacewalks in giant swimming pools. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
